Market today: Treasury yields easing and oil falling back below $100 are the main drivers, which could offer some relief to growth names. However, record diesel prices are still a concern for the broader economy.
Your holdings: SOXL (-51.41%) and SPAL (-30.02%) are still in the red and flagged for attention. Remember, these leveraged ETFs amplify drops, especially on margin.
Watch: Keep an eye on SMCI and GOOGL. Both have strong scanner setups and are in areas that could offer value.
Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for any signs of a broader tech recovery.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL if they show further weakness; these leveraged ETFs are bleeding you dry on margin.
Consider trimming QQQI if it breaks below 52, its stop level.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
